user_story: As a user, I want to navigate through the multi-level dropdown menu so that I can access various options like Downloads and file formats. Acceptance criteria: When I visit 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/jqueryui/menu', I should see the menu with the items: 'Disabled', 'Should not see this', 'Enabled', 'Downloads', 'PDF', 'CSV', 'Excel', 'Back to JQuery UI'. The URL should not change when I interact with the 'Disabled' menu item.
